en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a sparse settlement in an arid landscape. Several low colonial‑style buildings with verandas stand on open ground with little vegetation, surrounded by hills or mountains in the distance. Simple walls and a small house-like structure appear in the right foreground. Printed captions at the top read "Mindelo" on the left and "S. Vicente C. V." on the right.
